project_type: MQL5 MetaTrader 5 Expert Advisor (single-file trading bot) for XAUUSD, with a Python analysis harness on the side
language: MQL5 (C-like). Python 3 stdlib for tooling only.
build_system: MetaEditor (MQL5 compiler) on the user's Windows PC. NO compiler and NO MT5 in this Linux sandbox - cannot compile or backtest here.
test_framework: No unit tests for the EA. Correctness is verified by careful read-through + MQL5 knowledge, and ultimately by the user's next MT5 Strategy Tester backtest on Windows (Fusion Markets, build 6191). tools/test_analyze_report.py covers only the Python analyzer, which is out of scope.
build_command: N/A in sandbox. User compiles GaganEA.mq5 in MetaEditor on Windows.
test_command: N/A in sandbox. User runs MT5 Strategy Tester: XAUUSD, tester Period M1, EA Trade_Timeframe M5, deposit 1000 USD, leverage 1:500, real ticks.
verification_instructions: 1) Re-read the full modified GaganEA.mq5 to confirm MQL5 syntax is valid for build 6191 (CTrade/CPositionInfo API, no undeclared identifiers, balanced braces, no non-ASCII in new code). 2) Confirm OnInit/OnTick structure and the dashboard are preserved. 3) Confirm every changed input default and every new/rewired function call is consistent. 4) grep for the old version string to confirm all occurrences were bumped. The authoritative pass/fail is the user's next backtest, which we cannot run.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None relevant. The EA compiles to GaganEA.ex5 on the user's PC (gitignored). No generated files in this repo need regenerating for this task.
setup_instructions: git checkout main && git pull --ff-only origin main. Work directly in the working tree on main. Do NOT commit or push - the orchestrator commits to main afterward. Only modify GaganEA.mq5 and (append-only) ITERATION_LOG.md.
environment_constraints: No MQL5 compiler, no MT5, no wine in the Linux sandbox - cannot compile or backtest. Do NOT fabricate performance numbers. Keep everything ASCII in any file touched (a prior bug was non-ASCII chars breaking tooling); note the EXISTING dashboard already uses some hex-escaped glyphs like \x25A0 and byte-escapes like \xE2\x9C\x93 - leave those as-is, just do not introduce new raw non-ASCII bytes.
contribution_requirements: No-PR, direct-to-main workflow. Do NOT change files other than GaganEA.mq5 and ITERATION_LOG.md. Preserve OnInit/OnTick structure and the dashboard. Make the DEFAULT input values conservative because the backtest harness does not override inputs. Bump #property version and dashboard title/comment to a new version (2.11).
key_patterns: Single-file EA. Inputs declared with 'input' groups near the top. pip = point*10 for 3/5-digit symbols so *_Pips inputs are POINTS on gold. Entries in OpenTrade() gated by HTF+CTF EMA trend, Min_EMA_Distance (measured in _Point), a detected candle/chart pattern, and DistanceCheckOK(). Lot sizing in CalcLotSize() = balance*Risk_Percent/100 / (slDist/tickSize * tickVal). Exits: ManageTargets (T1/T2/T3 partial closes via t1_tickets/t2_tickets arrays), ManageIndividualTrailing (only after T2), ManageBasketTrailing, CheckMasterEquityProtection, CheckEquityProtection (global close). CloseAllByType/CloseAllPositions do real closes.
relevant_files: GaganEA.mq5 - the ONLY source file to edit (~1678 lines)
README.md - context only (v2.10 feature list); do not edit unless asked
directory_structure: Repo root: GaganEA.mq5 (EA source), ITERATION_LOG.md, README.md. automation/ (Windows backtest harness - do not touch). reports/ (HTML backtest reports + samples). tools/ (Python analyzer - out of scope).

known_issues_confirmed_by_reading.dead_functions: ApplyMasterTrailing (line ~1015) and ApplyTrailingToTickets (line ~1045) are DEFINED but NEVER called anywhere. Confirmed via grep: only the definitions appear, no call sites. The master/basket protection instead relies on CloseAllByType (which does close), and per-position real-SL trailing only happens in ManageIndividualTrailing AFTER T2. So open positions before T2 have only the fixed 2500-pt SL.
known_issues_confirmed_by_reading.reward_risk: StopLoss_Pips=2500, T1=800/close 65%, T2=1200/close 80%, T3=2000/close 100%. Winners closed early and small; losers run to 2500. Avg win 0.55 vs avg loss 0.89.
known_issues_confirmed_by_reading.stacking: DistanceCheckOK only enforces Min_Trade_Distance=20 points (~$0.20 on gold) between same-side entries. No cap on concurrent position COUNT and no account-level max-open-risk guard. Entries can stack heavily.
known_issues_confirmed_by_reading.overtrading: All 15 candlestick + 10 chart patterns enabled; Reversal_Min_Confirmations=2; entry attempted on every new M5 bar with no cooldown; Min_EMA_Distance=150 (in _Point). ~100 trades/day observed.
known_issues_confirmed_by_reading.version_strings: GaganEA v2.10 / 2.10 appears at lines 2, 15, 16, 282, 304 and dashboard title near line 1393 (' GaganEA v2.10').
